name: taste2

description.en: W-TASTE2 (operator 2026-10-06). (1) AI ON BY DEFAULT: settings key ai.enabled defaults to 1 (dowiz_hub::settings::known, features::FEATURES default_on true); an owner's stored 0 stays off and sends nothing; with no route (no own https endpoint, no [ai] binding, or the venue's daily Workers AI share spent) every caller fails soft -- Suggest answers the lexicon draft (200, ai.provider null), Q&A answers from the folds. /api/owner/integrations reports ai.enabled truthfully and ai.usable = the provider plan has a route. (2) SERVER 'FOR YOU' on the order-tracking page: GET /api/order/:id/taste/for-you with the order's own link token answers up to 3 dish ids from dowiz_hub::block::taste::top_k over the venue's taste.dwb against the venue's own profile of the guest (its decayed sense weights, else the phone's last taste_sync.sense); only for a guest with a server profile; state off after the one-tap objection (nothing read), no-profile, no-taste; the guest card's allergens excluded by mask before ranking, the dishes of this order left out; ids and taste words only, never a number, never a price; 404 for an order with no phone. The phone's own strip is unchanged. (3) The open-meteo.com credit (CC BY 4.0) is drawn in the owner's segment builder beside its weather filter (store/sense-view.js weatherSourceLine). (4) S7 (R-S7 research 2026-10-06): S7a the consistency radius (L-inf per mille between the phone's vector and the venue's profile, over guests with both) on GET /api/owner/health as `sheaf.taste` {compared,maxPm,medianPm,overHalf,acts:false}, a neutral row on the health sheet and a `sheaf.radius` log line -- never an alarm, nothing acts on it; the stock cover waits for S0 glue. S7b the Suggest answer adds `recipe`: the harmonic extension (Q16 Gauss-Seidel, <= 60 sweeps) of the declared dishes' taste over the dish-supply graph from the blocks taste/menu_prices/bom/names; state no-recipes | no-recipe | no-neighbours | faint | drafted (draft + why from=recipe + neighbours + passes) | no-block | unreadable; never merged, never written. S7c tools/gates/migration-law.sh: every stock record kind and block schema must have its newest version registered with a law test that exists.
description.uk: ШІ увімкнено типово (власник може вимкнути); «Для вас» на сторінці замовлення з серверного профілю (лише з профілем, заперечення поважається, без цін); подяка open-meteo у конструкторі сегментів; радіус узгодженості в здоровʼї закладу, підказка смаку з рецепта, гейт законів міграції.
